COUNTY OF PLACER
                               PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA
                               THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 24, 2026
                                         9:00 A.M.
                                    MEETING LOCATION:
                            PLANNING COMMISSION HEARING ROOM
                        3091 COUNTY CENTER DRIVE, AUBURN, CA 95603
The Planning Commission meeting will be open to in-person attendance. The entire meeting will also be available
on livestream. Public Comment will be opened for each agenda item, and citizens may provide comments in person
or virtually through a Zoom meeting webinar utilizing the “raise hand” function or via phone at 877-853-5247 using
the Webinar ID 943 9294 4680. If joining by phone, please dial *9 to “raise hand” and queue for Public Comment.
Please raise your hand at the time the Chair announces the item. There will be no reservation line. The meeting
livestream and webinar may be accessed at: https://www.placer.ca.gov/pclive.

Materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Commission after distribution of the agenda packet are
available for public inspection at the Clerk of the Board of Supervisors’ Office, 175 Fulweiler Avenue, Auburn, during
normal business hours. The Clerk’s office will attempt to post online any written or emailed public comments
received at least two days prior to the meeting, but all correspondence and documents received will be retained by
the Clerk as part of the administrative record. Citizens may submit their comments in written form by emailing
comments to the Clerk of the Board at planningcommission@placer.ca.gov or mail the same through the U.S. Postal
Service to the County, Attn: Clerk of the Board, 175 Fulweiler Avenue, Auburn, CA 95603.

Placer County is committed to ensuring that persons with disabilities are provided the resources to participate fully
in its public meetings. If you are hearing impaired, we have listening devices available. If you require additional
disability-related modifications or accommodations, including auxiliary aids or services, please contact the Clerk of
the Board. If requested, the agenda shall be provided in appropriate alternative formats to persons with disabilities.
All requests must be in writing. Any requests received by the Clerk less than two business days prior to the
scheduled meeting for which the accommodation is requested will be accommodated only if time permits.

NOTE: THE APPLICANT OR AN AUTHORIZED REPRESENTATIVE SHOULD BE PRESENT IN ORDER TO
PRESENT INFORMATION AND/OR TESTIMONY RELATIVE TO THE APPLICATION(S). THE PLANNING
COMMISSION MAY TAKE WHATEVER ACTION THEY DEEM APPROPRIATE, WHETHER OR NOT THE
APPLICANT OR AN AUTHORIZED REPRESENTATIVE IS PRESENT.



FLAG SALUTE

ROLL CALL: Robyn Dahlgren, District 1; George Alves, District 2; Trent Jewell, District 3; Amber Beckler,
District 4 (Chair); Jeff Ronten, District 5 (Vice Chair); Mark Watts, At-Large East of Sierra Crest (Second
Vice-Chair); Richard Johnson, At-Large West of Sierra Crest.

CONSENT AGENDA: All items will be approved by a single roll call vote. Anyone may ask to address
Consent items prior to the Planning Commission taking action, and the item may be removed for
discussion and/or hearing.

PLANNING DIRECTOR REPORT:

PLANNING COMMISSIONER REPORT:

PUBLIC COMMENT: The public will be offered the opportunity to comment on matters not included on
the current agenda. The length of time devoted to this public comment period shall be as determined
appropriate by the Commission Chair.

PLANNING COMMISSION                                                                         PAGE 2
SEPTEMBER 24, 2026

                    HEARING ITEMS to be considered for action as time allows

1.    PLANNING SERVICES DIVISION
      A. Bickford Ranch Specific Plan – Phase 1 Small Lot Vesting Tentative Map Modification (PLN26-
          00256) and Fifth Amendment to the Corrected Amended and Restated Development Agreement
          (PLN26-00255), Supervisorial District 3
          1. Conduct a public hearing related to the Bickford Ranch Specific Plan and make a
               recommendation that the Board of Supervisors take the following actions:
               a. Determine that the proposed actions are within the scope of environmental analysis
                    evaluated in the previously certified Final Environmental Impact Report for the Bickford
                    Ranch Specific Plan and subsequently adopted addenda.
               b. Adopt an Ordinance approving the "Fifth Amendment to the Corrected Amended and
                    Restated Development Agreement” relative to the Bickford Ranch Specific Plan to modify
                    provisions related to the relocation of the Equestrian Staging Area, revise the timing
                    and funding obligations for construction of Sierra College Boulevard Segment 2, update
                    the Sierra College Boulevard Fee, and amend reimbursement provisions associated
                    with construction of Sierra College Boulevard Segment 2.
               c. Approve modifications to the corollary provisions of the Bickford Ranch Specific Plan
                    Phase 1 Small Lot Vesting Tentative Map Conditions of Approval to facilitate their
                    consistency with the above-described changes to the Development Agreement.
Project Location: The Bickford Ranch Specific Plan is located between the City of Lincoln and the
unincorporated Placer County communities of Penryn and Newcastle. The western boundary of the project
site is defined by Sierra College Boulevard from State Route 193 on the north side to English Colony Road
on the south.
Assessor Parcel Numbers: This request involves multiple APNs. Please refer to Attachment B, Exhibit 2
of the Staff Report for a complete list of the affected APNs.
County Staff: Sue Compton, Senior Management Analyst, County Executive Office


2.  PLANNING SERVICES DIVISION
    A. Rolling Greens Subdivision – Final Map Modification (PLN26-00242), Supervisorial District 4
         1. Conduct a public hearing to consider a request from the applicant, Natalie Hillenbrand on
            behalf of the property owner Randeep S. Chawla, for a modification to the approved Final
            Map for the Rolling Greens Subdivision, and take the following actions:
            a. Determine the project is categorically exempt from environmental review in accordance
                 with Section 15305 (Class 5 – Minor Alterations in Land Use Limitations) of the
                 California Environmental Quality Act Guidelines and Section 18.36.070 of the Placer
                 County Environmental Review Ordinance (Placer County Code Chapter 18).
            b. Approve a modification to the previously approved Rolling Greens Subdivision Final
                 Map to expand the building envelope for Lot 7, subject to the Modified Conditions of
                 Approval, and direct the county surveyor to record a certificate of correction reflecting
                 this modification.
Project Location: 9160 Stowe Place in the unincorporated Granite Bay area
Assessor Parcel Numbers: 050-230-007-000
County Staff: Joe Plumley, Assistant Planner

PLANNING COMMISSION                                                                       PAGE 3
SEPTEMBER 24, 2026


3.  PLANNING SERVICES DIVISION
    A. Loomis Ranch Subdivision – Modification to the Phase I and II Final Maps (PLN24-00131),
         Supervisorial District 3
         1. Conduct a public hearing to consider a request from the applicant/property owner, Mike
            Mendez, for modifications to the Loomis Ranch Subdivision’s Phase I and II Final Maps and
            take the following actions:
            a. Adopt the Mitigated Negative Declaration (State Clearinghouse Number 2026030857),
                 erratum, and Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program prepared pursuant to the
                 California Environmental Quality Act and Section 18.16.010 of the Placer County
                 Environmental Review Ordinance.
            b. Approve modifications to the Final Maps for Phase I and II of the Loomis Ranch
                 Subdivision to remove the Wetland Preservation Easement areas on Lots 7 and 11,
                 and allow construction of two driveways to access the rear of the parcels, subject to
                 the Recommended Conditions of Approval, and direct the county surveyor to record
                 certificates of correction memorializing these modifications
Project Location: 4865 Clover Ranch Lane in the unincorporated Loomis Area
Assessor Parcel Numbers: 030-030-075-000 and 030-030-068-000
County Staff: Jared Peters, Associate Planner


4.  PLANNING SERVICES DIVISION
    A. Alchemy Surf Resort – Tentative Subdivision Map, Conditional Use Permit, Design Review
        Agreement and Variance (PLN 25-00227), Supervisorial District 2
        1. Conduct a public hearing and take the following actions:
            a. Determine that the proposed Alchemy Surf Resort project is consistent with the land
                 uses and zoning identified within the previously certified Sunset Area Plan/Placer
                 Ranch Specific Plan Final Environmental Impact Report, Mitigation Monitoring and
                 Reporting Program, and addenda, and there are no project-specific significant effects
                 which are peculiar to the project or its site; therefore, no further environmental review
                 is required.
            b. Approve a Tentative Subdivision Map for the approximately 32-acre project site
                 property, subject to the Recommended Conditions of Approval.
            c. Approve a Conditional Use Permit for Outdoor Commercial Recreation uses in the
                 Campus Park – Parkway (CP-PW) district of the Placer Ranch Specific Plan, subject
                 to the Recommended Conditions of Approval.
            d. Approve a Design Review Agreement for the Alchemy Surf Resort project, subject to
                 the Recommended Conditions of Approval.
            e. Approve a Variance from Placer County Code Section 17.54.180(A)(1)(a) – Number of
                 freestanding signs, to allow for three freestanding monument signs where two are
                 normally allowed, subject to the Recommended Conditions of Approval.
Project Location: North of Placer One Boulevard, east of Foothills Boulevard North and south of the
planned Placer Parkway in the northeast corner of the Placer Ranch Specific Plan.
Assessor Parcel Numbers: 017-500-039-000, 017-500-040-000, 017-500-041-000, 017-500-042-000,
017-500-043-000, 017-500-044-000, and 017-500-045-000
County Staff: Kara Conklin, Senior Planner

PLANNING COMMISSION                                                                     PAGE 4
SEPTEMBER 24, 2026

                                             CONSENT ITEMS
All items will be approved by a single roll call vote. Anyone may ask to address Consent items prior to
the Planning Commission taking action, and the item may be removed for discussion and/or hearing.


5.   PLANNING COMMISSION CLERK
     A. Minutes
         1. Approve the minutes of the September 10, 2026, Planning Commission Meeting.



ADJOURNMENT – To next regular meeting.
